card.title: Wonderful, It’s Impossible
card.instruction: Celebrate every impossible development as a breakthrough that removes old limitations and creates exciting new problems.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The kettle's floating! Tea no longer needs a table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone upstairs. I promised Mum breakfast in bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct delivery! We can retire the breakfast tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on her ceiling. She wants me to bring the tray back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, breakfast has an upstairs! I'll rig the tray on pulleys. Ask Mum how high she likes her toast.

mechanism: A celebrates a floating kettle as liberation from furniture and treats its rising reach problem as a new breakfast-design opportunity.
confusable: Unlike practical acceptance of the bizarre alone, A must positively celebrate each development as expanded possibility including its new difficulties.
comparison: The kettle alternative designs vertical breakfast service; the wall-entry alternative celebrates a rain-exposed dining room as umbrella seating.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
